instruction: Mark all emails in the Bills folder as unread

rules.sql: select sum(1) = 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13);

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in Bills folder (folderID=13) as unread. The evaluator checks that NO messages in Bills have attributeID=59 (read) set to value=1. SQL returns 1 (true) if count is 0. Verified from database: Bills has 2 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird SQLite database containing email metadata
SQL query correctly checks that NO messages in Bills folder (folderID=13) have read attribute (attributeID=59) set to 1
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird before reading database to avoid locking issues
Query logic is sound: 'sum(1) = 0' returns 1 (pass) when no read messages exist, 0 (fail) otherwise
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement that all Bills emails are unread
Edge cases handled: empty folder would correctly return 1, database locking prevented by postconfig

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
